_note: chief tier — `claude --mcp-config` shape. Same portable gitnexus stdio server, used READ-ONLY: read-only is a usage convention for the Chief (code intelligence without write authority); the absence of coding tools in chief.json allowlist is what actually enforces it. Plus the K-owned kstore working store (work-items, lessons; status-write self-gates to workflow runs) and the mgmt working store (assignments/reports — the Chief's management STORAGE; storing an assignment does NOT dispatch a lead). The synthesizer rewrites `__KSTORE__` / `__MGMT__` + the env placeholders at run time.
